sections.title: Otto J. Krause — WWII B-17 navigator
sections.summary: Otto J. Krause of Detroit served as a navigator with the 91st Bomb Group, 324th Bomb Squadron, Eighth Air Force, based at RAF Bassingbourn. He flew mostly on B-17 Mah Ideel (43-37993 DF-N) with Lt. William Laws’ crew, earned the Air Medal with oak leaf clusters, and finished as a First Lieutenant. He married Geraldine Staub around 1945.
highlights: Unit: 91st Bomb Group / 324th BS / 8th Air Force, RAF Bassingbourn
Aircraft: Mah Ideel B-17G 43-37993 (codes LL-U then DF-N); ~72 missions; returned USA 11 Jun 1945; scrapped Kingman AZ Dec 1945
Laws crew (Otto navigator): mostly Mah Ideel; co-pilot Bernard “Ed” Goldstein KIA 30 Nov 1944 on another crew
Sample Mah Ideel missions (Halpert list): Ludwigshafen, Schweinfurt, Merseburg/Leuna, Cologne, Berlin (3 Feb 1945)
Awards: Air Medal + oak leaf clusters (late 1944 orders)
Wartime photo FRE 5634 by Dale Darling shows Otto with a B-17
Married Geraldine Staub ~1945

sections.title: Frederick Charles Crosier & Dolores Marie Altz
sections.summary: Frederick Charles Crosier (29 Sep 1925 – 25 Feb 2020) married Dolores Marie Altz Crosier (22 Oct 1930, Oakland County, MI – 11 Dec 2005, Rochester Hills, MI) on 17 May 1952. Their children include Kathleen Marie, Kenneth Frederick, Kerry Michael, Kevin Jerome, Kristopher J., and Karolyn Crosier. Frederick served in WWII (branch/unit not yet found online). Family-confirmed railroad career: Penn Central and Conrail; last location Sterling Yard (off 16 Mile near Van Dyke, Sterling Heights). Public context: that yard sits on the old Michigan Central Detroit–Bay City line (later New York Central, then Penn Central from 1 Feb 1968, then Conrail from 1 Apr 1976). Sterling Yard’s south end (“WS”) is between 15 and 16 Mile; the yard itself is near 16–17 Mile and served heavy auto traffic (Chrysler Sterling Heights assembly/stamping; Ford plants via the Utica Industrial Track / Van Dyke corridor). No public employee roster naming Frederick has been found yet. Later work: Universal Computer Systems (Rochester Hills area, family-confirmed) — the best-known firm by that name was the Houston auto-dealership software company that merged into Reynolds and Reynolds in 2006 and had Detroit-area field presence; a smaller local shop of the same name is also possible. Dolores worked in a school cafeteria (school unknown) and quilted. Modetz funeral listing confirms dates but has no published career narrative.

sections.title: Lozon brothers — WWI Canadian service
sections.summary: Two of Madeline’s brothers appear in Canadian WWI records from Wallaceburg. Solomon Alex Lozon (sapper #3131895) enlisted Feb 1918 with the 1st Western Ontario Regiment, sailed to England May 1918, and served in France before returning in 1919. Peter Adolphus (Dulphy) Lozon (#3134471), born 29 Aug 1896, enlisted July 1918 and was discharged early 1919.

sections.title: Gerald Krause & Karolyn Crosier Krause
sections.summary: Gerald Francis Krause (b. 20 Dec 1953), son of Otto J. Krause and Geraldine Staub, married Karolyn Dolores Crosier (b. 1 May 1959), daughter of Frederick Charles Crosier and Dolores Marie Altz. They have been married at least 40 years (church wedding; exact date/place still open). Their children are Jeremy Francis, Emily Elizabeth, Elizabeth Ann, and Ann Emily Krause. Public death notices for Dolores (2005) and Kathleen (2009) name Karolyn (Gerald) Krause. Family memory: Karolyn worked briefly for Rochester Avon Recreation Authority (RARA), then was a stay-at-home mom; Gerald put himself through college while living in a trailer park (school still open; an earlier “Baker” guess likely refers to son Jeremy’s Baker College degree); Gerald taught history in Detroit at Greenfield Union Elementary-Middle School (420 W. 7 Mile Rd.), near the 8 Mile area, roughly from the late 1980s through the mid-2010s. That school’s former principal Beverly Campbell was among the educators charged in the 2015–16 DPS Norman Shy kickback scandal. Rochester school years (family memory): Karolyn attended Rochester Adams High School and went to school with Madonna’s sister (Paula Mae Ciccone, b. 22 Aug 1959 — same birth year as Karolyn). Madonna (b. 16 Aug 1958) was a little older, graduated Adams in 1976, and once went on a date with Gerald’s brother Eric. People-search records place Karolyn D. Krause in Troy, Michigan.

sections.title: Jeremy, Emily & Elizabeth Krause
sections.summary: Ann’s older siblings (family-confirmed). All four Krause kids attended Sterling Heights High School (Warren Consolidated Schools). Emily and Ann were also selected into the Macomb Mathematics Science Technology Center (MMSTC) at Butcher Educational Center in Warren — a competitive half-day math/science/tech magnet; home-school courses stayed at Sterling Heights. Approximate ages from people-search: Jeremy ~39, Emily ~37, Elizabeth ~34 (Ann b. 1997). Jeremy — Target backroom trainer (15 Mile & Dequindre) since 2008; Baker College B.B.A. ~2010–2016 (likely the Baker memory earlier attributed to Gerald). Emily — Sterling Heights valedictorian, strong track athlete, full-ride to Central Michigan University; CMU triple-major B.S. in Statistics, Mathematics, and Actuarial Science (~2007–2011), then M.A. Mathematics (~2011–2012); grad teaching assistant for Intermediate Algebra; co-author of SIAM Undergraduate Research Online “Spread of a Rumor” (2013); Dialer Analyst at Credit Acceptance (Southfield) from ~2015; spouse Kwame Larry. Elizabeth Ann — Saginaw Valley State University teaching degree, then an online master’s in teaching (program/school still open).
